# QB-05: team pressure, allowed by his line vs generated by the opponent (pre-registered 2026-11-02)

**Status: PRE-REGISTERED.** Written before any score was seen; the only runs
before this were `--coverage-only` (coverage and the leak check, no score).
The other checks looked at the features' own distributions and at how much
of each team rate is signal rather than sampling noise; none read points.

## Idea
Roadmap QB-05, "Team pressure generated vs allowed", from participation
`was_pressure` (to 2025) and play-by-play sacks and hits. The roadmap's
note: team level fixes the PFR coverage gap. FEATURE_EXPANSION's `+pfr`
block tested the QB's own PFR pressure rate, season to date, which exists for
only 13% of 2025 rows, and failed (1 of 7 folds). This block is team level
and covers every row.

The shipped QB set has no pressure or sack input. What overlaps:
`def_allowed` (the opponent's QB points allowed, against the league: a
defense that pressures allows fewer), `implied` (the team total), and his own
`xfp_*` and `fpoe_season` (a QB pressured all season already shows it in his
efficiency).

## Hypothesis
A QB behind a line that allows pressure, or facing a defense that generates
it, completes fewer and shorter passes and takes more sacks, so he scores
less than his volume and the matchup's points allowed say. Pressure is a team
tendency, close to efficiency, so it enters slowly (rule #6): last season's
rate, and this season's rate to date shrunk toward the league by how little
of it is signal after a few games.

## Features (`COLUMNS`)
| column | position | definition, as of the weeks before the row's week | source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `own_press_allowed_prior` | QB | his team's (this week's team) share of its own regular-season dropbacks in season s−1 that participation marks pressured, among the dropbacks where pressure is recorded; minus the league's share that season | nflverse participation `was_pressure` × play-by-play dropbacks |
| `own_sackhit_allowed_std` | QB | his team's dropbacks with a sack or a QB hit, this season's games before the week: (x − n·p) ÷ (n + 150), with n its dropbacks, x those with a sack or hit, p the league's share over the same weeks. The rate shrunk toward the league's with 150 pseudo-dropbacks, minus the league's | play-by-play `qb_dropback`, `sack`, `qb_hit` |
| `opp_press_gen_prior` | QB | the opponent defense's pressured share of the dropbacks it faced in s−1, minus the league's share | participation × play-by-play |
| `opp_sackhit_gen_std` | QB | the opponent defense's sack-or-hit share of the dropbacks it faced, this season before the week, the same way with 400 pseudo-dropbacks | play-by-play |

A dropback is `qb_dropback == 1` (passes, sacks, scrambles). A sack that is
also a hit counts once (1,243 of 2024's 1,314 sacks carry `qb_hit`).

**The shrinkage** is set from the rates themselves, never from points:
k = p(1 − p) ÷ τ², with τ² the between-team variance of full-season rates
left after the sampling variance (method of moments, 2018–2025). Offense,
sack or hit allowed: τ = 0.028, k ≈ 160. Defense, sack or hit generated:
τ = 0.018, k ≈ 390. Rounded to 150 and 400. A defense's rush is the noisier
of the two. The prior-season pressure rates are not shrunk: every team has a
full season of dropbacks, so shrinking would only rescale them.

Missing when: never for the 2019–2025 rows (every team has a prior season,
and earlier games by week 4). A missing value would enter as 0 plus
`<col>__known`.

Real share: participation records pressure on 89.0% (2018), 89.2% (2019),
89.6% (2020), 89.2% (2021), 88.7% (2022) and 100% (2023, 2024) of
regular-season dropbacks, the seasons the priors read. (DATA_INVENTORY.md's
84–85% counts play-by-play `pass == 1` plays, a wider denominator: 83.9% in
2019 on it.) The prior-season rates
rest on those plays. The league's pressure rate is 28.5–31.2% by season, and
each rate is centered within its season, so the 2023 change of source cannot
shift the feature. Sack-or-hit is play-by-play, 100% of dropbacks (14.0–15.0%
of them by season).

Shared builders: `scripts/research/blocks/_p4_participation_priors.py`
(package P4). It joins participation to regular-season play-by-play on
(game, play), so participation's playoff plays never enter.

## Test
- Positions: QB.
- Seasons: 2019–2025, seven season folds (`block_runner.py`).
- Bar: better than the shipped set on start/sit pairwise AND MAE in every
  fold, on QB rows; pooled not worse in any fold.
- Coverage seen before registering (no scores):
  - `own_press_allowed_prior`: 2019 100%, 2020 100%, 2021 100%, 2022 100%, 2023 100%, 2024 100%, 2025 100%
  - `own_sackhit_allowed_std`: 2019 100%, 2020 100%, 2021 100%, 2022 100%, 2023 100%, 2024 100%, 2025 100%
  - `opp_press_gen_prior`: 2019 100%, 2020 100%, 2021 100%, 2022 100%, 2023 100%, 2024 100%, 2025 100%
  - `opp_sackhit_gen_std`: 2019 100%, 2020 100%, 2021 100%, 2022 100%, 2023 100%, 2024 100%, 2025 100%
  - leak check: passed (2021 week 9, 2024 week 14)

## If it passes
Record-only contender for two live weeks (ground rule 3), then a
DECISIONS.md row. Nothing serves after the week-14 board. Live in 2026 the
priors read 2025 participation, which is published; 2027 needs nflverse's
2026 participation.
